messages:
lena: Quick follow-up from the RFC review: instead of a big cut, I want to propose an "adapter mesh" approach with clear phase gates. Reason: lower blast radius, easier rollback, and measurable quality checks. High level phases: shadow -> canary -> gradual swap -> cleanup.

oliver: Love the mesh idea. Can you outline what constitutes a "phase gate"? My suggestion: contract parity, telemetry equivalence, perf safety, and automated rollback criteria.

tara: For contract parity we should use a golden-response set + fuzzed inputs. If the adapter produces different shape, we log and tag but don't fail shard-level traffic during shadow. Also: add a header X-RI-Adapter to trace.

yuri: Perf safety: require p50 within baseline and p95 within +20% during canary. If the adapter sees queueing or a spike in tail latencies, the rollout pauses and auto-fallback triggers. We should capture a short snippet of rollout config: 
```yaml
adapter_rollout:
  phases: [shadow, canary, ramp]
  ramp_schedule: [0,1,5,25,60,100]
  perf_gate:
    p95_multiplier: 1.2
    evaluation_period: 15m
  fallback: auto_pause_and_rollback
```

oliver: Also add semantic-drift metric: compare decoded outputs on a sample set, compute a drift_score; fail gate if >0.7% over 24h. That prevents subtle regressions in text/semantics.

tara: CI flakiness note: contracts that rely on external infra are flaky. Let's have two tiers: fast unit-level contracts in PR, and nightly full-contract run against staging with the golden set.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach runbook to any rollout PR and include incident playbook link (/runbooks/rollback-adapter.md). Automated pager will be enabled for canary spikes.

lena: Ownership proposal: infra owns adapter runtime and rollout automation; owning product team owns semantic golden set and behavioral tests; SRE owns runbook & pager thresholds. Any objections?

yuri: One more: for stateful pieces we need a safe-swap pattern: snapshot -> dual-write -> reconcile -> read-switch. Feature flag must support read-mode and write-mode toggles separately.

oliver: Action items:
- lena: write the phase-gate definition doc and rollout template by Thu
- tara: assemble golden set + fuzz harness and publish to infra/contract-sets
- yuri: add perf gate checks to rollout automation and define p95 alert thresholds
- ops-bot: scaffold runbook template PR (will link pager rules)

lena: Let's meet Wed 9am PT to align on gating thresholds and cutover runbook. Closing note: keep the adapter intentionally thin; push complex policy/transform logic to the owning service. Small adapter surface = easier testing and future modularization. :thumbsup:
meta: adapter mesh, phase gates, shadow/canary/ramp, golden set, perf gates, runbook
